scope: Registered real Store sole-writer durable attention journal and atomic outbox wake intent; no transport activation

registration.state: real Store registration was temporarily present for all listed checks; lib.rs excluded from source commit and restored after checks
required_calls: rebuild and backup attention::validate_all before projection/publication

invariants_demonstrated: Immutable project/root/epoch/config/predeclared recipients; existing journal cannot be replaced/reset
Both accepted observe and take_delivery commands/ticks replay through actual AttentionGovernor
Original immutable receipt bytes/digest/batch/tick/outbox ID retained on historical exact retry; only outer replayed changes
Expected-prior CAS, concurrent Store calls, command/source collision, cross-project and caller root/recipient/epoch changes refuse
New Wake and NEW outbox enqueue co-commit through existing transaction helper; even ExistingExact foreign rows refuse
Late injected journal SQL failure rolls back outbox, decision, head and governor budget consumption
Consumed ordinary/reserve budget survives actual Store reopen/rebuild/backup; unknown outbox remains unknown with no re-enqueue
Progress storm coalesces governor references while accepted input history and protected blocker/question transitions remain recorded
Independent recipient reserves, unknown/backwards ticks, source capacity and 64-journal limit without eviction/reset
Canonical sequence/projection/command/receipt/outbox identity validation and bounded borrowed stored text; corrupt/oversized/wrong-type fixtures refuse reopen/rebuild/backup
Borrowed whole wake envelope checked against16KiB before Value allocation, caller metadata4KiB; rejected envelope does not consume budget
contents.failure_interpretation: Initial two focused runs exposed fixture expectations (progress-only pending count, invalid contract digest, envelope-size threshold), repaired without weakening governor. Strict Clippy rejected an oversized enum; boxed Observe payload preserves JSON wire bytes. Initial ValueRef null API compile failure was observed in tool output; no persistent log was fabricated.
limits: Component tests use real Store writer requests through excluded temporary registration; source commit alone is intentionally not registered. Root must integrate exact registration and requalify aggregate source.
Trusted Store seam is not caller/source authentication, route authorization, execution/provider authority, transport/application ACK or provider context delivery.
One fixed project/root per journal, up to16 declared recipients; budgets are per journal and recipient, not a global cross-project Admiral budget.

No journal reset/retirement/compaction or checkpoint authority; explicit global backpressure64 journals/4096 commands/8MiB command+receipt JSON. Row/counter caps do not qualify SQLite/WAL/disk growth.
Source evidence is retained as bounded immutable references; artifact custody/availability and source grant verification remain external.
Logical ticks and outbox schedules are caller-recorded inputs; no wall-clock inference, unknown zero-fill, token/cost/savings or acceptance inference.
Unkeyed digests do not authenticate a database owner able to rewrite all evidence and constraints.
SQL faults/corruptions are controlled fixture injections, not a complete power-loss/fsync crash qualification.
No remote/fleet/provider/credential/service effects, CI trigger, whole-workspace rerun or live governor activation.
P05/P06 and all wider parent acceptance remain open.
